name: Skins of the Slain
prerequisites: trained in light or medium armor
text:
The hides and bones of mighty beasts and the leaves and bark of the old-cold forest become your second skin, concealing your body and leaving it unhindered to better partake in the wild hunt. You gain the armor specialization effects for light and medium armor from the leather, skeletal, and wood armor groups. You don't become Fatigued if you sleep while wearing such armor.

In addition, while you wear such armor, you can Impersonate creatures with the animal, beast, fey, or plant traits, so long as they're either the same size as you or one size larger. Impersonate gains the illusion and primal traits when used this way. Impersonating a larger creature doesn't change your size.
